thread:
Hana: Quick flag — weekly KPI board shows an odd divergence: launch-post MQLs dropped ~33% during the webinar push window, while our benchmark cohort stayed flat. Screenshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/launch-compare.png

Omar: Interesting. Could be routing vs creative. Any spike in 'direct' or 'unknown' channel attribution?

Priya: Ran a quick extraction: ~210 registrations in the window with utm_campaign empty. SQL I used:
```sql
SELECT utm_campaign, count(*) FROM registrations WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-13' GROUP BY utm_campaign;
```
NULL bucket is big.

Dana (mktg-ops): FYI we rolled a redirect tweak on Mar 9 to support the webinar provider. I'll pull the redirect logs; possible querystring drop on 302.

analytics-bot: Alert: cohort="launch-posts" attribution drift +31% vs baseline. See /alerts/4135

Hana: Proposed triage: 1) add referrer fallback for missing utm, 2) reprocess last 72h with campaign-precedence, 3) flag the KPI deck with before/after numbers. Agree?

Omar: Agree on steps. Also suggest a small table in the deck showing "utm present" vs "src only" conversion to separate routing vs creative issues.

Priya: I'll open a tiny PR for frontend fallback. Snippet:
```js
const campaign = url.searchParams.get('utm_campaign') || parseReferrer(document.referrer) || cookies.get('campaign_last');
```
I'll run unit tests and tag ops.

Dana (mktg-ops): I'll coordinate a 20m pause on SFDC imports during reprocess and notify SDR leads. ETA 45m.

Hana: Perfect. For the weekly KPI review I'll include an "Attribution note" slide and both raw and reprocessed metrics so execs see the delta.

analytics-bot: Deploy queued: deploy/web#4135 in ~8m. Will post status.

Omar: After reprocess can someone run `scripts/compare_kpi.sh --cohort launch-posts --window 72h` and paste CSV?

Priya: Got it — will do and post results.

Hana: Thanks team — let's sync 12:50 ET to confirm numbers. :sparkles:
